name: Citrulline malate

lead: Citrulline malate combines the amino acid L-citrulline with malic acid. Citrulline is an intermediate of the urea cycle and a precursor of arginine, and is a staple of pre-workout powders.

It is used for muscle pump, endurance in resistance sets and reduced soreness. Meta-analyses find a small improvement in repetitions to failure with low certainty, and single trials often show no effect.

paras: Citrulline is converted to arginine in the kidney, which raises nitric oxide production and blood vessel dilation. It may also help clear ammonia and lactate-related fatigue, and malate may feed energy metabolism, though these steps are not firmly proven for performance.

Citrulline malate is legal and generally well tolerated; the main complaint is stomach upset at larger amounts. It can lower blood pressure slightly, relevant for people on antihypertensive or erectile dysfunction drugs. Benefits for muscle size are not established.
